v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me. ‡
text.en: Lord, * thou hast proved me, and known me. ‡

text.la: Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
text.en: Wonderful are thy works * and my soul knoweth right well.

text.la: Ne derelínquas me, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
text.en: Do not thou forsake me, * O Lord, the strength of my salvation.

text.la: Dómine, * clamávi ad te, exáudi me. ‡
text.en: I have cried to thee, * O Lord, hear me. ‡

text.la: Educ de custódia * ánimam meam, Dómine, ad confiténdum nómini tuo.
text.en: Bring my soul * out of prison, O Lord, that I may praise thy name.

text.la: Tu autem, Dómine Sábaoth, qui iúdicas iuste, et probas renes et corda, vídeam ultiónem tuam ex eis: tibi enim revelávi causam meam, Dómine, Deus meus.
text.en: But thou, O Lord of Sabaoth, who judgest justly, and triest the reins and hearts, let me see thy revenge on them: for to thee I have revealed my cause, O Lord my God.

v.la: Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo.
v.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man.

r.en: Rescue me from the unjust man.

text.la: Príncipes sacerdótum * consílium fecérunt ut Iesum occíderent: dicébant autem: Non in die festo, ne forte tumúltus fíeret in pópulo.
text.en: The chief Priests * consulted that they might kill Jesus, but they said: Not on the Feast-day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui protectiónis tuæ grátiam quǽrimus, liberáti a malis ómnibus, secúra tibi mente serviámus.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who seek the grace of thy protection, being delivered from all evils, may serve thee ever in peace and quietness of spirit.
